load_rgb_image: load an RGB image from file path and return it as a normalized float32 tensor
get_random_cuda_device: get a random CUDA device string from available GPUs for testing custom kernels
assertClose: test two tensors or arrays are close within relative and absolute tolerance
assertNormsClose: test two tensors are close using a custom norm function with tolerance thresholds
assertSeparate: test that two tensors have their data stored in distinct memory locations
